tools.name: get_services
tools.description: What VoiceDesk AI does: capabilities (available / guided / not available), supported industries, how onboarding works and what agents may and may not do.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current monthly plans from VoiceDesk AI's live plan catalog (USD): monthly price, one-time setup fee and included call minutes. Purchases happen only on voicedeskai.org by the business owner.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Check whether VoiceDesk AI fits a business: country, industry template, required capabilities (use capability ids from get_services) and, given expected monthly call minutes, the smallest suitable plan.
